optimizer: Adam default parameters; fresh state per arm

criteria.T0: same initial checkpoint, paired wave/u draws, identical 200x4 batch schedule and optimizer settings; full finite evaluation, weight hashes unchanged during evaluation
criteria.T1: over six noncubic held-out cases: geometric means of B200/A200 macro nMAE ratios AND x Eq5 MRE ratios <=0.8
criteria.T2: mean macro nMAE on three 32^3 held-out cases: B200/A0 <=1.1
criteria.T3: mean over six axis/polarization maxima of transverse trunk intervention: B200/A0 <=1.0

limitations: only one paired optimization seed, not an estimate of training variability
200-update pilot, not a fully converged training comparison
expanded range is a diagnostic enhancement, not the paper original training setting
validation seed 10/11/12 cases are evaluated only after both arms finish; no checkpoint selection
